Senior Software Engineer

Acme Fake

San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)

About the role

Acme Fake is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design and operate the distributed event-processing pipeline that powers our industrial robotics platform. You will own end-to-end backend services in Python and Go, partner with hardware engineers, and lead architecture reviews.

Required

  • 7+ years building production backend systems
  • Strong Python or Go; comfort with one of the other
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience in production
  • PostgreSQL at scale; partitioning, replication, schema migrations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • Distributed systems publications or open-source contributions
  • Experience with real-time data pipelines (Kafka, Pulsar)
  • ML platform exposure (model serving, feature stores)

Compensation

$220,000 - $280,000 base + equity + benefits
